risks.note: The Secretarial Audit Report for the year lists numerous instances of delayed or non-compliant disclosures and filings — late disclosure of a corporate guarantee (Form CHG-1), late final dividend payment, utilisation of preferential-issue proceeds before filing Form PAS-3, non-filing of several allotment disclosures in XBRL mode, delayed disclosure of the withdrawal of a credit rating, delayed disclosure of the Vyom Hydrocarbon/Quippo share acquisition and subsequent loss of control, delayed Regulation 30 disclosure of the Quippo acquisition, and stock-exchange fines for non-compliant Board composition (Independent Director ratio) in September and December 2025 — indicating a pattern of governance and disclosure-process weakness.
risks.risk: Repeated regulatory/compliance lapses under SEBI LODR and Companies Act

risks.note: The Company was fined by stock exchanges for failing to maintain the required proportion of Independent Directors (at least half the Board) at two points during the year, once with only 5 of 11 Directors independent and once with only 3 of 8 Directors independent, following director resignations.

Three Independent Directors — Robert Jonathan Moses, Mukund Shriniwasrao Bilolikar, and Pramod Kumar — resigned before completion of their tenure during the year, which along with the compliance lapses above increases governance/board-stability risk.

The position of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer was vacant from July 07, 2025 to February 12, 2026, beyond the period prescribed under Regulation 6(1) of SEBI LODR; management attributes several of the XBRL/disclosure filing lapses during the year to the absence of a professional Company Secretary during this period.
risks.risk: Company Secretary and Compliance Officer vacancy
